note: Both sets extract only the ~100 issues/concerns fact from the first bullet and ignore the other three bullets. Set A restates that fact twice more but misbinds the value: it attributes 100 findings to the Draft Final Reports and 100 as a quantity of mission concepts (there are four mission concepts), with fragmentary quotes. Set B keeps the value bound to LCIT review issues/concerns with a supporting quote, but states the same fact three times. Set B is therefore more faithful, though highly redundant.
remarks: Both sets miss the page's other facts: findings provided to STDTs before public release, STDT modifications after LCIT and Red Team reviews, STDT feedback/summary of changes per finding, and the significant reduction of remaining issues after re-review. Set A's second and third claims look like degenerate re-extractions of the same sentence with the value attached to the wrong entity.
